reasoning: The substance is right: EO 13106 sec. 7 expressly supersedes EO 13071, and no earlier end appears in the held corpus. The pay schedules have no end of their own, the savings analysis is sound, and the quotes and hashes all verify. But every end date in the claim (whole_order_end and all 14 first_end entries) is 1995-12-07. That is three years before the actual supersession of 1998-12-07, two years before EO 13071 was issued, and contrary to the claim's own judgment_reasons and rationale. A wrong exact end date with an internal inconsistency requires rejection, even though the outcome (status no, ended by EO 13106) is correct. With every date corrected to 1998-12-07 and nothing else changed, the claim would merit upholding.
